security_audit.summary: Ten static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, official URLs, HTML entity decoding, and multilingual text. Two temporary-file alerts expose local overwrite or tampering risks; an additional finding addresses stale announcements after failed downloads. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential collection, exfiltration, or hidden code execution.

remediation.issue: A predictable shared temporary file permits symlink overwrites and local announcement tampering.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with restrictive permissions and pass its unique file path between download and parsing steps. Remove it afterward.

remediation.issue: The workflow can parse stale content after a failed download.
remediation.suggestion: Require successful curl completion and HTTP status before parsing a newly created file. On failure, report unavailable data and link the official source.

content.user_title: Check Taiwan Work and School Suspension Announcements
content.value_statement: Disaster-related work and school suspension information changes quickly, and unofficial messages can mislead readers. This skill checks DGPA announcements and reports source quotations with query times.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the public DGPA suspension announcement page without an API key or login.
Extract county and city announcement text from the designated announcement table.
Recognize the table message indicating no suspension announcements.
Report announcement quotations with the query time and official source.
Direct readers to the official page when parsing fails, without predicting future announcements.
limitations: The source page shows current status, not a historical announcement archive.
Private employer decisions and individual school notices require separate verification.
The author reports synthetic tests for announcement rows, not a live typhoon-day test.
The workflow requires network access, curl, and Python; its shared temporary file needs hardening.

use_cases.title: Check School Suspension Notices
use_cases.description: Review the current official announcement for a county or city before checking a school's separate notice.

use_cases.title: Verify Government Work Status
use_cases.description: Look up the published work suspension announcement and retain its wording, source, and query time.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Sourced Public Update
use_cases.description: Collect current county announcements for a factual update without adding predictions or treating them as private employer decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Taiwan's current official work and school suspension announcements. Include the source and query time.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One City
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the current DGPA announcement for Kaohsiung City. Quote the published wording and include the query time. Do not infer missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Tomorrow Question
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether DGPA has announced tomorrow's work or school suspension for Taipei City. State the announcement date and query time. Do not predict.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Verified Regional Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve fresh DGPA data and verify download success. Summarize all published county announcements verbatim with applicable dates, source, and query time. Flag parsing failures.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative response when the announcement table says no suspension information is available.
output: Illustrative response, not a live status check: DGPA currently lists no work or school suspension announcements.
Query time: [actual retrieval time]. Source: DGPA's official suspension announcement page.
No future suspension is confirmed by this result. Private employers and individual schools may issue separate notices.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative response when the announcement table cannot be parsed.
output: Illustrative response: The current announcement table could not be read reliably.
I cannot confirm work or school suspension status. Please check https://www.dgpa.gov.tw/typh/daily/nds.html directly.
No status has been inferred from old data or memory.

best_practices: Require a successful fresh download into a private temporary file before reporting current status.
Preserve announcement wording, applicable dates, official source, and actual query time.
Recheck changing announcements and verify private employer or individual school decisions separately.
anti_patterns: Predicting tomorrow's suspension when no applicable announcement is available.
Presenting cached content or remembered announcements as a fresh status check.
Treating government announcements as binding decisions for every private employer or individual school.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves a public DGPA page without an API key or login.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Running the documented workflow requires network access, curl, and Python.

faq.question: Can it confirm whether my private company closes?
faq.answer: No. Government announcements are a reference; confirm the decision with your employer.

faq.question: Can it predict tomorrow's typhoon suspension?
faq.answer: No. It reports published announcements and states when an applicable announcement is not available.

faq.question: Can it retrieve past suspension announcements?
faq.answer: Not from the documented page. That page reflects the latest status rather than a historical archive.

faq.question: What happens if retrieval or parsing fails?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to report unavailable data and refer you to the official page. Freshness checks need implementation hardening.
